raw.details:
Overview

Techkriti' 27 presents Speed Quant: a high-octane challenge that merges mathematical brilliance with rapid problem-solving. This competition isn't just about finding the right answers; it's about mastering the clock, making smart choices, and staying ahead of the competition.

Event Structure

Round 1: Online Round

  • Format: Multiple-choice or numerical quantitative aptitude questions.
  • Total Questions: 60 questions.
  • Duration: 30 minutes.
  • Marking Scheme: +1 for a correct answer, else 0 in any case.
  • Flexibility: Questions can be revisited any number of times during the test.

Round 2: Onsite Finale (IIT Kanpur – Techkriti' 27)

  • Format: Numerical/short answer type quantitative mathematical questions.
  • Total Questions: 8 questions in total.
  • Duration: 60 minutes.
  • Difficulty & Topics: Varies from moderate to difficult, incorporating brainstorming, probabilistic knowledge, and mathematical problem-solving.

Guidelines & Regulations

  • Participation: Speed Quant is an individual-rated contest—registrations must be made individually.
  • Eligibility: Open to students or professionals across the world.
  • Prize Claim Requirements: In order to claim the prize money, participants must register on both the contest platform and Techkriti's official website.
  • Rules & Fair Play: Any participant found indulging in malpractice or plagiarism will be immediately disqualified by Techkriti, IIT Kanpur.
  • Final Authority: Participants must strictly follow all guidelines. In case of any disputes, the final decision rests with Techkriti's Team, IIT Kanpur.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

  • How many rounds are in the competition? There are two rounds: an online round followed by a final round where teams/participants compete onsite at Techkriti, IIT Kanpur.
  • How will the winner be decided? Combined scores of Round 1 and Round 2 will be used to determine the winner of the competition.
  • Who will be declared winner in case of a tie? If two or more participants have the same score, the participant who took less time for submission will be given preference.
